hits.title: Infinite Probabilistic Databases
hits.snippet:
Probabilistic databases (PDBs) model uncertainty in data in a quantitative way. In the established formal framework, probabilistic (relational) databases are finite probability spaces over relational database instances. This finiteness can clash with intuitive query behavior (Ceylan et al., KR 2016), and with application scenarios that are better modeled by continuous probability distributions (Dalvi et al., CACM 2009).

hits.title: Graph Neural Networks for Databases: A Survey
hits.snippet: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are powerful deep learning models for graph-structured data, demonstrating remarkable success across diverse domains. hits.title: YouZhi: Towards High-Concurrency Financial LLMs via Adaptive GQA-to-MLA Transition
hits.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) drive significant financial innovations, yet their high-concurrency deployment is severely bottlenecked by KV cache memory overhead, which inflates infrastructure costs and throttles scalability. hits.title: Cascade: Token-Sharded Private LLM Inference
hits.snippet: As LLMs continue to increase in parameter size, the computational resources required to run them are available to fewer parties. Therefore, third-party inference services -- where LLMs are hosted by third parties with significant computational resources -- are becoming increasingly popular.
